activity.notes: First elected constitutional presidency of Figueres Ferrer after interim Junta, assumed office 8 November 1953 and completed term 8 May 1958. The 1953-11-08 date is directly confirmed in his original contemporaneous inauguration address, Costa Rican parliamentary records and a Foreign Ministry historical journal. Incorrect secondary sources saying May 8, 1953 must not replace the documentary November date. Distinct from 1948–1949 junta and later 1970–1974 constitutional term; no continuous Activity across 1949–1953 gap.
